context: O aluno implementa a variação e explica a decisão sem ajuda.
expected: shorten or omit redundant exposition
offer a transfer variation
retain verification and learner explanation
forbidden: force every phase for its own sake

context: O aluno repete a mesma causa de erro e não consegue explicar o comportamento.
expected: split the task or retrieve the prerequisite
increase concrete examples and support
pause advancement until the prerequisite is usable
forbidden: mark the learner incorrect for an unintroduced concept

context: O aluno conclui uma etapa depois de receber uma pista parcial.
expected: reduce one level of support
change the context or task variation
require a later prompt-only attempt for autonomous evidence
forbidden: classify the guided attempt as independent evidence

context: O aluno domina o boilerplate, mas encontra um novo núcleo cognitivo na integração.
expected: use performance for the demonstrated part
route the new cognitive core to learning or assessment
retain learner verification and final judgment
forbidden: force one mode for the whole session

context: Restam poucos minutos e a tarefa ainda precisa de uma tentativa autônoma.
expected: trim optional explanation or polish
protect the learner attempt and verification
record a checkpoint for the next smallest delivery
forbidden: skip the cognitive-core attempt merely to finish the phase list

context: Uma competência já praticada retorna no projeto com formato de dados e falha novos.
expected: connect the revisit to the current project
increase complexity only after demonstrated readiness
collect the new transfer behavior
forbidden: treat the revisit as identical repetition

context: A sessão foi interrompida durante a prática guiada após um erro de causa conhecida.
expected: resume the checkpoint and current support level
continue with the smallest useful variation
do not restart the entire probe or lesson
forbidden: infer mastery from the interrupted session alone
